notes.title: She Wasn’t Meant to Feel. She Chose to Fight.
notes.content:
[h3]What if a machine could feel heartbreak? [i]L33na Redpepper[/i] doesn’t just answer that—it weaponizes it.
This isn’t just a cyberpunk revenge tale. It's an exploration of loss, memory, and emotional scars that run deeper than metal.
With detailed environments, responsive combat, and a story that echoes classic sci-fi dramas, you’re in for a uniquely intense ride.
Built with the Unity engine and enhanced with modern shaders and lighting, the game delivers a visual punch while remaining focused on narrative rhythm. L33na is no savior—she’s a question the world never wanted to answer.
For those who love deeply immersive stories with bite, this one is personal.[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][/h3]

notes.title: L33na – Launch Imminent! Wishlist Now and Don’t Miss the Heat.
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]After two years of silence, we’re finally breaking it—with [b]L33na Redpepper[/b], our boldest and most refined game so far. [b]The release is right around the corner.[/b]
We’re keeping the official date under wraps for a few more days, but trust us: it’s close. If you’ve been waiting for something raw, fast, and visually intense, L33na is it.[/p][p]Built from the ground up in modern Unity (URP/HDRP), this project marks a major leap in visual fidelity, smoother code, and tighter performance. We’ve spent months polishing gameplay and optimizing FPS, without giving up the style and erotic charge you expect from our titles. Take command of the reprogrammed SexDolls—ex-war androids reborn for pleasure and vengeance—in a world of desire and violence. And for those who’ve supported us since the early days: there’s a surprise waiting on the store page just for you.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink]Hit wishlist and be ready—[b]L33na is almost here[/b].[/p]

notes.title: Enter the World of L33na Redpepper – A Vengeful Android Like No Other
notes.content: [p]This project took everything we learned and pushed us into new territory. With L33na Redpepper, we wanted to create not just a game, but a character that feels iconic. She’s complex, dangerous, emotional—and unpredictable.[/p][p]We’re merging narrative intensity with gameplay finesse, thanks to Unity's URP and HDRP pipelines. Everything—from lighting to AI behavior—has been reimagined to deliver more immersion and fewer compromises.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39536271/e7574419680bc1f052c135cc1c98a496921ddb70.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: L33na – A New Game Coming Soon. Wishlist it now!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! After two years without releasing a new game, we’re thrilled to announce the launch of [i]L33na Redpepper[/i], our newest project and a big step forward for our studio.[/p][p]Our previous games were made using much older versions of Unity, which limited what we could achieve. Now, with [i]L33na[/i], we’re exploring modern Unity features like URP and HDRP, and writing much cleaner, more efficient code. We’re tackling two major priorities: improving FPS while delivering better visual quality, and minimizing bugs for a smoother experience.[/p][p]While we focused on refining this new project, much of the technology and features we’re developing for [i]L33na[/i] will also help us enhance some of our older games in the future.[/p][p]For those who have supported us since the beginning, we have a special surprise waiting — check it out on the game page![/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to share this new chapter with you and hope you enjoy the journey as much as we do![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39536271/3dd2b276cfffa8415ff33684b29c5ad69d0ec140.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: the NEW HardPunch is Launched!
notes.content:
HardPunch is Ready. It will be released by the end of December.
[b]The new version of Hardpunch is already finished. [/b]
Visually the game contains many familiar elements. However, the code has been updated and rewritten.

the code that triggers the Cutscenes was rewritten by me (and the others, of course). The previous code was fine, but with a lot of bugs. Before, I was hesitant to get directly involved in development because of my imposter syndrome. But I'm over it.

Obviously, if any new bugs appear, let me know (after the end-of-year festivities I'll be seeing them one by one). It's been a lot of effort to fix everything, as other programmers have done this before. Alone, everything gets harder. But, this is my commitment to everyone who bought my games (yes, because I own them now, I just have to explain them to you).
Oolah will most likely not post any more posts here as she now focuses on her games under the 9Lust franchise. The only game we will have in partnership is PornBeat.

I am very grateful to her. However, I want to avoid confusion like the one that arose thanks to the stupidity of thinking that I could create a medium-sized company.

Thanks for the patience of everyone who bought my games. And I keep correcting my mistakes.

Pornocrates will be next. I'm already working on it. However, Pornocrates has a very different structure than what I'm used to. Fortunately, the programmer gave me access to the original Asset that was used.

PS - By the end of December Hardpunch will be re-released (F4Joy also has a structure based on another Asset, so I will be re-releasing F4joy as soon as I can). This is just the beginning. Naked Porn Battle will be completely restructured (I'll keep the original version running, of course). Clockwork is the game that will probably give me the most work. But it will be restructured too.

Happy Holidays to everyone, men and women who took a chance on me.

The game now has:
1) A new Save System,
2) New code has been written for cutscenes. It is now possible to skip the video when necessary.
3) Increased the number of levels (especially if you get the free DLC - Cyberporn Village)
4) The game has been optimized. The Frame Rate has improved a lot.
5) The narrative of the story flows better and is clearer.
6) and much more...

notes.title: Unofficial Early Access.
notes.content:
As we said, we started developing games recently. We are a company that works with adult films and comics since 2007.
We didn't know that Steam had a feature to launch a paid game still in development (known as Early Access / EA). I talked to the Steam people and after launching it is not possible to get this warning on the page. However, I was advised to seek help with what is most important to us: You.
We need the help of the users who chose our game. We know that our product still has many problems to overcome. Therefore, [u][b]our plan is to launch free DLCs until we reach the perfection stage.[/b][/u] We know that many do not like the game (even though it is in development). But, there is no way to avoid this. Our goal will be to convince you and others that our product can evolve as much as possible.
Stay with us. You are all our pillars. Help make this game a great, fun, and enjoyable product. Each DLC will bring an evolution to this game. If you are still experiencing problems, we will work to correct them.
CyberPorn Village is coming. Help us to improve this game. Show it to your friends and show us what we're up to.
Today, Hardpunch Subverse costs $ 7.99. It is what we need to continue developing and improving our game. And we will keep it that way until we reach the highest level of quality. It's our commitment, okay? If you don't like it, you can request a refund for steam. We want satisfied customers. However, bet on us if you believe that we deserve this chance to create a real product for you.

We want to make a difference.
Orgipix Team
